Travel Insurance

Business travel opens doors—but it also comes with risks. From flight cancellations and lost luggage to medical emergencies abroad, unexpected events can disrupt plans and impact your bottom line.

Travel Insurance ensures your team stays protected wherever work takes them.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Travel Insurance, which indemnifies losses and damages against travel inconveniences either domestically or internationally. It likewise covers repatriation in case of death while on travel and remunerates the insured's identified dependent in case of accidental death.

Travel Insurance covers the following common risks:
• Medical expenses
• Emergency evacuation / repatriation
• Trip cancellation / interruption
• Accidental death, injury, or disablement benefit
• Overseas funeral expenses
• Trip curtailment
• Flight delay
• Loss, theft, or damage to personal possessions and money (including travel documents)
• Delayed baggage
• Legal assistance
• Personal liability and rental car damage excess

What is the information needed for Travel Insurance?
• Per Trip
o Applicant's name
o Person/s to be insured
o Itinerary
o Departure dates
o Arrival dates
o Preferred amount of insurance
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
• Annual
o Applicant's name
o Person/s to be insured
o Geographical limit
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
